definitions.gloss: petty trick; cheap ploy; small-time scheming
definitions.explanation: A small, shallow trick used to gain an advantage or hide something, which a capable person would not need. Always disapproving.

examples.japanese: {小細工|こざいく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通用|つうよう}→通用：04530_tsuuyou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
{小細工|こざいく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's take them on head-on, without any cheap ploys.

examples.english: Even if you fudge the numbers with little tricks, the real situation will come out sooner or later.
